goal: Add Drizzle schema for `applications` (UNIQUE on userId), generate+apply migration with RLS, and create server actions `submitApplication` (upsert) and `getMyApplication` (read own row).
summary: Phase 1 complete: backend plumbing for the application table is in place. Schema (`src/db/schema/applications.ts`) defines `applications` with text IDs, `.enableRLS()`, FK cascade to `user.id`, UNIQUE on `user_id`, JSONB responses, and a text array of dept ids. Migration (`drizzle/0003_cooing_sentinels.sql`) generated and applied to the live Supabase DB with RLS enabled and a manually-appended RESTRICTIVE policy `users manage own applications` TO authenticated using `(select auth.uid())::text = user_id` (the `::text` cast is required because `auth.uid()` returns `uuid` and `user_id` is `text`). Server actions (`src/lib/actions/applications.ts`) expose `submitApplication(input)` (Zod re-validation, upsert via `onConflictDoUpdate`, `revalidatePath("/join")`) and `getMyApplication()` (returns row or null). Both throw `Unauthorized` if no session. Project verify (`pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build`) all exit 0 with the /join route still in the route table (existing client component, slated for replacement in Phase 2).
stepSummaries:
1. Create src/db/schema/applications.ts: define `applications` table with `pgTable` from drizzle-orm/pg-core — id (uuid PK defaultRandom), userId (uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE with FK references('user','id',{onDelete:'cascade'})), depts (text().array().notNull()), responses (jsonb().$type<Record<DeptId, unknown>>().notNull()), createdAt (timestamp().defaultNow().notNull()), updatedAt (timestamp().defaultNow().notNull().$onUpdate(() => new Date())). Export the inferred row type. The `.unique()` on userId produces a UNIQUE constraint in the generated SQL. [verified]
  2. Register the new schema in src/db/schema index (if one exists) or import it where the Drizzle client is constructed. Run `pnpm db:generate` to produce a migration SQL file under drizzle/. Inspect generated SQL — verify it includes CREATE TABLE applications with UNIQUE (userId) and the RLS policy. If RLS is not auto-generated, append manually (e.g. `ALTER TABLE applications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "users manage own" ON applications FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (auth.uid() = "userId") WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = "userId");`). [verified]
  3. Run `pnpm db:migrate` (drizzle-kit push) against the configured Supabase DB to apply the migration. Verify by inspecting the live DB or running a quick `SELECT * FROM applications LIMIT 0` query via a test script. [verified]
  4. Create src/lib/actions/applications.ts ('use server'): export (a) `submitApplication(input: unknown): Promise<{ ok: true; id: string } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — resolves session, re-validates against a server-side ApplicationSchema (defined locally to avoid coupling server to client component), upserts via `db.insert(applications).values({ userId, depts, responses }).onConflictDoUpdate({ target: applications.userId, set: { depts, responses, updatedAt: new Date() } }).returning({ id: applications.id })`; (b) `getMyApplication(): Promise<{ ok: true; application: ApplicationRow } | { ok: true; application: null } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — resolves session, returns the user's row or null. Both throw if no session. [verified]
  5. Verification: run `pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build` — all must exit 0. Confirm the new table is registered and migration applied. [verified]
